messages:
marta: Quick microbench ask — can someone run a short hit-rate sweep across node pool 7/8? Seen eviction spikes on stage when seq len hits 2048. Want fragmentation + per-slot occupancy, plus eviction/time series so we can correlate with KV compaction cycles. Ideally short runs (5m each) for seq 128/512/2048 and prefix-heavy traffic.

jamie: @marta I can run this on node7 and node8 in ~10m. Any specific bench flags? :ok_hand:

marta: Use bench-runner with KV profiling and emit json metrics. Example command:```
bench-runner --profile=kv_hitrate 
  --nodes=node7,node8 
  --seq-lens=128,512,2048 
  --workload=prefix-heavy 
  --batch=8 
  --sample-window=300s 
  --emit=kv_metrics,json 
  --label=mc-2003-hitrate-sweep
```Also please set --kv-trace=on for one run to capture fragment snapshots (rotate to s3 afterwards).

lee: fyi i'll disable the compactor on node8 during the 2048 runs so we can see fragmentation without background compaction noise. curl toggle below (staging API):```
curl -X POST https://staging-infra/api/compactor/toggle -d '{"node":"node8","state":"off"}' 
```Will flip back after.

jamie: queued. Running node7 seq=128 first. scheduling job id 2003007785. benchbot should post status.

benchbot: job 2003007785 queued -> running on node7 (seq=128). emitting metrics to s3://redwood-perf/microbench/mc-2003-hitrate-sweep/2003007785.json

jamie: quick sanity logs from node7 (seq=128):
```
node7.metrics: {"hit_rate":0.95,"eviction_rate":0.0012,"frag_index":0.06}
node7.kv_sample_counts: total_slots=64000, occupied=18320
```

sara: nice — can we also tag per-model-size? small vs medium vs large tends to change KV footprint. add --model-tag if possible.

marta: good call. add --model-tag=llama-7b,llama-13b for the 512/2048 runs.

jamie: node8 seq=2048 done (compactor was off per @lee). quick snapshot:```
node8.metrics: {"hit_rate":0.68,"eviction_rate":0.024,"frag_index":0.31}
node8.kv_sample_counts: total_slots=64000, occupied=42100
node8.kv_frag_samples: top_frag_buckets=[0.18,0.24,0.37]
```

marta: wow — frag_index jump on 2048 as suspected. eviction rate goes up ~20x vs 128. That aligns with more large prefixes thrashing slots. Can we run a controlled compaction run (single cycle) and rerun seq=2048 to see delta? If compaction reduces frag_index and eviction, we have a mitigation path.

lee: will schedule compaction run on node8 in 30m and then re-run the 2048 workload. I'll also capture pre/post heap/slot histograms.

jamie: re-run scheduled after compaction. job id 2003007810.

benchbot: job 2003007810 queued -> running (post-compaction re-run on node8).

jamie: post-compaction logs:```
node8.metrics: {"hit_rate":0.84,"eviction_rate":0.0065,"frag_index":0.12}
node8.kv_sample_counts: total_slots=64000, occupied=39800
```

marta: excellent — clear win from compaction. We'll capture details and propose an intermittent compaction policy for high-2048 windows. I'll open a perf PR with the metrics + suggested policy (compaction throttle + adaptive threshold). @lee can you add the histograms to the PR when you have them?

lee: yup will attach histograms and the compactor toggle logs.

jamie: +1, will drop raw jsons in the perf bucket and link them in the PR.

marta: thanks all. Next steps: create perf PR, schedule a longer 1hr run across more nodes once we agree thresholds. Filing follow-up ticket now. :spiral_notepad:
